text:
Nora Quill: hey folks! i'm Nora — started today as UX Researcher. based in SF, pronouns she/they. i'll be in the office Mon/Wed/Fri. big fan of sunrise sketching and i actually kayak to the pier sometimes (yes, really). desk is 4F by the east window. brought a small wooden sketchbook — anyone up for a doodle swap? :wave:
Sam: welcome aboard Nora!!! :tada: kayaking commute?? you have to tell me your route sometime. also, we have a lunchtime sketch circle on Wednesdays if you want to drop in.
Juniper: hi Nora, welcome! love the sketch swap idea. there's an art shelf in the kitchen for tiny trades. also we have a roof sunset photo channel if you ever want inspo.
Arlo: welcome!! boardgame + sketch nights exist. ping me if you want to join the next one. :boardgame:
Ben (IT): Hey Nora — badge enrollment completed. When you get to the 2nd-floor lobby tell reception "Nora Quill" and they'll hand it to you. If you'd like a standing desk, reply here and I'll queue the request (avg turnaround 2-3 days).
Nora Quill: awesome, thanks Ben! please add me to the standing desk list if still possible.
Mira: welcome Nora — i'm the snack steward for the week. we have oat milk and a tiny herb corner in the kitchen. also the art shelf is legit, put your sketchbook there if you want to swap. :coffee:
deploy-bot: Onboarding checklist updated for Nora Quill — badge_assigned, intro-meet scheduled.
Sam: FYI, there's a volunteer kayaking meetup Sat 9am from Pier 40 if you want to try group paddle. layers advised.
Nora Quill: omg yes i'll try to make the Sat paddle. this is already better than orientation. thanks everyone :heart:
Arlo: :thumbsup: see you around the east windows!
Mira: also adding you to #lunch-plans so you can see daily plans.
